title: Loading overlay
summary: Covers a region (or the whole viewport with fullscreen) with a spinner and a label while busy, and makes what it covers inert so it cannot be clicked or tabbed into. With delay and min-time it owns the one busy timing rule (pk-page and Blazor's PageBase use it); both default to 0.

props.name: busy
props.description: Show the overlay and make the content inert (after delay, for at least min-time). aria-busy follows it at once.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds busy must last before the overlay appears, so a fast action never flashes it (about 150 for a page). 0 shows it at once.

props.name: minTime
props.description: Milliseconds the overlay stays once shown, so it never flickers (about 300 for a page). 0 hides it as soon as busy ends.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: The solid chip holding the spinner and label

a11y: The overlay is a polite status region announcing the label; the covered content is inert and aria-busy while busy.
mobile: The label wraps inside a solid panel; the spinner is 28px; on a region taller than the screen the panel stays in view.
